{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgRAvNQ5DYyXzpv3feyWC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportBalances.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Balances\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger report balances` command lists each account with its transaction count and balance, then a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md |\n| Provides | ledger report balances |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.balances.balance_cents, cli.output.write_table, ledger_app.store.open_store |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report balances` computes, from stored transactions, one row per account ordered by account\ncode, followed by a TOTAL row. Every value is aggregated in integer cents in the service layer from list\nresults; no value is hardcoded.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report balances` takes no further arguments. A wrong argument count is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Open the store through `open_store`.\n2. List accounts (ordered by code) and list transactions.\n3. For each account, count its transactions and sum their amounts in integer cents.\n4. Write the header `account,name,transactions,balance`, one row per account, then\n   `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>` where count is the number of transactions across all accounts and sum is\n   the sum of all balances. Amounts are formatted with two decimals.\n5. With no accounts the output is the header and `TOTAL,,0,0.00`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: list accounts by code - supplies: none - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n\n## Reads\n\nAccounts and transactions. Writes: none.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC balances-rows ===\nIntent: The balances report shows each seeded account with its transaction count and balance computed from stored rows.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef fmt(c):\n    return f\"{Decimal(c) / 100:.2f}\"\n\na1, a2, cat = \"ZZRB1\", \"ZZRB2\", \"ZZRBC\"\nn1, n2 = \"Report One\", \"Report Two\"\nplan = {a1: [100050, -2500], a2: [750]}\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=a1, name=n1)\n    db.accounts.create(account=a2, name=n2)\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Report category\")\n    tid = 900001000\n    for acct, amts ===\nIntent: A transaction stored between two report runs changes the reported balance and count by exactly its amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\ndef row_for(out, acct):\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    return {r[0]: r account=acct, category=cat, amount=second, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    after = row_for(out, stdout.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Categories\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger report categories` command lists every category with transaction count, inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md |\n| Provides | ledger report categories |\n| Consumes | cli.output.write_table, ledger_app.store.open_store |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report categories` totals stored transactions by category, including categories that have no\ntransactions, and ends with a TOTAL row. Aggregation is done in integer cents from list results.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report categories` takes no further arguments; a wrong argument count exits 2.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Open the store through `open_store`.\n2. List categories (ordered by code) and list transactions.\n3. For each category count its transactions; `inflow` sums positive amounts; `outflow` sums the\n   absolute values of negative amounts and is written as a positive number; `net` is\n   `inflow - outflow`.\n4. Write the header `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net`, a row for every category,\n   then `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.\n5. With no transactions, every category shows 0 transactions and 0.00 for inflow, outflow, and net,\n   followed by the zero TOTAL row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: list categories by code - supplies: none - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `category`, `amount`\n\n## Reads\n\nCategories and transactions. Writes: none.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC categories-rows ===\nIntent: The categories report shows computed inflow, outflow, and net for a used category and zeros for an empty one.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef fmt(c):\n    return f\"{Decimal(c) / 100:.2f}\"\n\nused, empty, acct = \"ZZRCA\", \"ZZRCB\", \"ZZRCACC\"\namts = [10000, 2550, -3000]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Cat Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=used, description=\"Used category\")\n    db.categories.create(category=empty, description=\"Empty category\")\n    for i, c in enumerate(amts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900002001 + i, date=\"2026-05-05\", account=acct, category=used,\n            amount=c, memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    by = {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:-1]}\n    inflow = sum(c for c in amts if c > 0)\n    outflow = sum(-c for c in amts if c < 0)\n    r = by[used]\n    assert r[1] == \"Used category\"\n    assert r[2] == str(len(amts))\n    assert r[3] == fmt(inflow)\n    assert r[4] == fmt(outflow)\n    assert r[5] == fmt(inflow - outflow)\n    z = by[empty]\n    assert z[2] == \"0\"\n    assert z[3] == fmt(0)\n    assert z[4] == fmt(0)\n    assert z[5] == fmt(0)\n=== END AC categories-rows ===\n\n=== AC categories-order-total ===\nIntent: Category rows are ordered by code and the TOTAL row equals the column sums with net equal to inflow minus outflow.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\nacct = \"ZZRCACD\"\ncats = [\"ZZRCD2\", \"ZZRCD1\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Total Account\")\n    for i, c in enumerate(cats):\n        db.categories.create(category=c, description=\"Total \" + c)\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900002101 + i, date=\"2026-05-06\", account=acct, category=c,\n            amount=(500 if i == 0 else -200), memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    data, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    codes = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert codes == sorted(codes)\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(int(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[3]) == sum(cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[4]) == sum(cents(r[4]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[5]) == cents(total[3]) - cents(total[4])\n    assert all(cents(r[4]) >= 0 for r in data)\n=== END AC categories-order-total ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every category appears, including those with no transactions.\n- `outflow` is a positive number; `net` is `inflow - outflow`.\n- Never hardcode a total; all values come from stored rows in integer cents.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Monthly\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger report monthly` command lists each month that has transactions with count, inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md |\n| Provides | ledger report monthly |\n| Consumes | cli.output.write_table, ledger_app.store.open_store |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report monthly` groups stored transactions by the `YYYY-MM` prefix of their date and reports\neach month in ascending order with a TOTAL row. Aggregation is in integer cents.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report monthly` takes no further arguments; a wrong argument count exits 2.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Open the store through `open_store`.\n2. List transactions and group by the first seven characters of `date`.\n3. For each month count transactions, sum positive amounts as `inflow`, sum absolute values of\n   negative amounts as `outflow`, and compute `net = inflow - outflow`.\n4. Write the header `month,transactions,inflow,outflow,net`, one row per month that has\n   transactions in ascending order, then `TOTAL,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.\n5. With no transactions, write only the header and the zero TOTAL row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `amount`\n\n## Reads\n\nTransactions. Writes: none.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC monthly-rows ===\nIntent: Stored transactions change their month's count, inflow, outflow, and net by amounts derived from the fixtures.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\ndef parse(out):\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    return {r[0]: (int(r[1]), cents(r[2]), cents(r[3]), cents(r[4])) for r in rows[1:-1]}\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZRMACC\", \"ZZRMC\"\nfixtures = [\n    (\"2098-01-05\", 10000),\n    (\"2098-01-20\", -2500),\n    (\"2098-02-03\", 700),\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Monthly Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Monthly category\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    assert code == 0\n    before = parse(out)\n    for i, (day, c) in enumerate(fixtures):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900003001 + i, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=c, memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"month\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    after = parse(out)\n    for month in sorted({d[:7] for d, _ in fixtures}):\n        amts = [c for d, c in fixtures if d[:7] == month]\n        inflow = sum(c for c in amts if c > 0)\n        outflow = sum(-c for c in amts if c < 0)\n        b = before.get(month, (0, 0, 0, 0))\n        a = after[month]\n        assert a[0] - b[0] == len(amts)\n        assert a[1] - b[1] == inflow\n        assert a[2] - b[2] == outflow\n        assert a[3] - b[3] == inflow - outflow\n=== END AC monthly-rows ===\n\n=== AC monthly-order-total ===\nIntent: Month rows ascend and the TOTAL row equals the sums of the month rows.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZRMAC2\", \"ZZRMD\"\ndates = [\"2097-03-01\", \"2097-01-10\", \"2097-02-11\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Monthly Order\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Monthly order\")\n    for i, d in enumerate(dates):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900003101 + i, date=d, account=acct, category=cat,\n            amount=(1000 if i != 1 else -300), memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    data, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    months = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert months == sorted(months)\n    assert len(months) == len(set(months))\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert int(total[1]) == sum(int(r[1]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[2]) == sum(cents(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[3]) == sum(cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[4]) == cents(total[2]) - cents(total[3])\n=== END AC monthly-order-total ===\n\n=== AC monthly-month-shape ===\nIntent: Every month label is a YYYY-MM value taken from stored transaction dates.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZRMAC3\", \"ZZRME\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Monthly Shape\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Monthly shape\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900003201, date=\"2096-12-31\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=100, memo=\"\"\n all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d{2}\", r[0]) for r in data)\n    assert \"2096-12\" in [r[0] for r in data]\n=== END AC monthly-month-shape ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Only months that have transactions appear as rows.\n- Never hardcode a month, count, or total; every value comes from stored rows in integer cents.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AtomicCommands.md ===\n# FEATURE: Atomic Commands\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Assembly of the member write commands proving that every rejected command checks everything first and changes nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-AccountAdd.md, FEATURE-AccountRename.md, FEATURE-AccountDelete.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-TxnAmend.md, FEATURE-TxnDelete.md, FEATURE-TransferRules.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md |\n| Provides | ledger atomic-command guarantee |\n| Consumes | ledger load, ledger account add, ledger account rename, ledger account delete, ledger txn post, ledger txn amend, ledger txn delete, ledger transfer |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nEvery write command validates all inputs and rules before its first write. This assembly story drives\nrejected invocations of each write command through the built CLI and compares a full snapshot of\naccounts, categories, and transactions before and after. Gaps found are fixed in the member stories'\ncode. Writes within one command share the persistence library's transaction scope where it offers\none, so two concurrent commands each complete in full or change nothing; the concurrent case is\nverified by the project's own pytest suite against a temporary database.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: list accounts - supplies: none - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: list categories - supplies: none - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC atomic-load-transactions ===\nIntent: A transaction file with an unknown account or a negative final balance is rejected with exit 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport dataclasses\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef tup(r):\n    if isinstance(r, dict):\n        return tuple(sorted(r.items()))\n    return dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\ndef write(path, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZAT1\", \"ZZATC\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Atomic One\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category\")\n    before = snap(db)\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        unknown = os.path.join(d, \"unknown.csv\")\n        write(unknown, [\n            [900004001, \"2026-06-01\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"ok one\"],\n            [900004002, \"2026-06-01\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"ok two\"],\n            [900004003, \"2026-06-01\", \"ZZNONE\", cat, \"10.00\", \"unknown\"],\n        ])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", unknown)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert snap(db) == before\n        negative = os.path.join(d, \"negative.csv\")\n        write(negative, [\n            [900004011, \"2026-06-02\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"deposit\"],\n            [900004012, \"2026-06-03\", acct, cat, \"-20.00\", \"overdraw\"],\n        ])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", negative)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-load-transactions ===\n\n=== AC atomic-load-lookups ===\nIntent: Account and category files with duplicate codes, stored codes, or short rows are rejected with exit 3 and store nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport dataclasses\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef tup(r):\n    if isinstance(r, dict):\n        return tuple(sorted(r.items()))\n    return dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\ndef write(path, header, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow(header)\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nstored = \"ZZAT6\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=stored, name=\"Stored\")\n    before = snap(db)\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        dup = os.path.join(d, \"dup.csv\")\n        write(dup, [\"account\", \"name\"], [[\"ZZATN1\", \"New One\"], [\"ZZATN1\", \"New Again\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", dup)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n        clash = os.path.join(d, \"clash.csv\")\n        write(clash, [\"account\", \"name\"], [[\"ZZATN2\", \"New Two\"], [stored, \"Clash\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", clash)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n        short = os.path.join(d, \"short.csv\")\n        write(short, [\"category\", \"description\"], [[\"ZZATK1\", \"Fine\"], [\"ZZATK2\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", short)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-load-lookups ===\n\n=== AC atomic-account-commands ===\nIntent: Rejected and not-found account commands change no stored record.\n\nimport dataclasses\n\nfrom cli.testing import return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\nacct, cat, absent = \"ZZAT2\", db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category two\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900004101, date=\"2026-06-04\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=500, memo=\"\"\n \"bad code!\", \"Invalid\")\n    assert code == 3 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", absent, \"Nobody\")\n    assert code == 4 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", acct)\n    assert code == 3 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", absent)\n    assert code == 4 and out == \"\"\n    assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-account-commands ===\n\n=== AC atomic-txn-commands ===\nIntent: Rejected and not-found transaction commands change no stored record.\n\nimport dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZAT3\", \"ZZATC3\"\ndeposit, withdrawal = 900004201, 900004202\nabsent_id = \"900004299\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Atomic Three\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category three\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=deposit, date=\"2026-06-05\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=withdrawal, date=\"2026-06-06\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-6000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before = snap(db)\n    cases = [\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-50.00\", \"2026-06-07\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, \"ZZNOCAT\", \"1.00\", \"2026-06-07\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-02-30\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.234\", \"2026-06-07\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"amend\", str(deposit), \"10.00\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"delete\", str(deposit)), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"amend\", absent_id, \"1.00\"), 4),\n        ((\"txn\", \"delete\", absent_id), 4),\n    ]\n    for args, want in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == want\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-txn-commands ===\n\n=== AC atomic-transfer ===\nIntent: Rejected transfers store neither leg, while a valid transfer stores both.\n\nimport dataclasses\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef tup(r):\n    if isinstance(r, dict):\n        return tuple(sorted(r.items()))\n    return dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\nsrc, dst, cat = \"ZZAT4\", \"ZZAT5\", \"ZZATC4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category four\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900004301, date=\"2026-06-08\", account=src, category=cat, amount=5000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before = snap(db)\n    cases = [\n        (\"transfer\", src, dst, \"500.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n        (\"transfer\", src, src, \"1.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n        (\"transfer\", src, dst, \"0.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n        (\"transfer\", src, dst, \"-1.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n        (\"transfer\", src, \"ZZNONE\", \"1.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n    ]\n    for args in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert snap(db) == before\n    count_before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-06-09\")\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == count_before + 2\n=== END AC atomic-transfer ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A rejected command writes nothing to stdout and stores no partial rows.\n- All inputs and the balance rule are checked before the first write of every command.\n- Concurrent-command atomicity is verified in the project's pytest suite, never by spawning processes in story acceptance.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-CliContract.md ===\n# FEATURE: CLI Contract\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Assembly of the ledger executable, usage-error behavior, and CSV output contract across every command. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-Count.md, FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-TxnGet.md, FEATURE-ReportBalances.md, FEATURE-ReportCategories.md, FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md |\n| Provides | ledger usage-error contract |\n| Consumes | ledger init, ledger count, ledger load, ledger account get, ledger txn get, ledger transfer, ledger report balances, ledger report categories, ledger report monthly |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`./ledger` exists at the application root and is executable. An unknown command, unknown table,\nunknown report, or wrong argument count exits 2 with exactly one stderr line showing the expected\nform and nothing on stdout. This story sweeps the command registry and confirms every registered\ncommand and sub-verb has a usage line and arity limits. Successful output is one header and\ncomma-separated unquoted rows with `\\n` endings and two-decimal amounts. Failures write nothing to\nstdout.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md and the member Feature files.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC contract-executable ===\nIntent: An executable named ledger exists at the application root.\n\nimport os\n\nassert os.path.isfile(\"ledger\")\nassert os.access(\"ledger\", os.X_OK)\n=== END AC contract-executable ===\n\n=== AC contract-usage-inprocess ===\nIntent: Unknown commands and wrong argument counts exit 2 with exactly one stderr line and no stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncases = [\n    (),\n    (\"frobnicate\",),\n    (\"report\",),\n    (\"report\", \"nosuch\"),\n    (\"load\", \"accounts\"),\n    (\"load\", \"nosuch\", \"file.csv\"),\n    (\"count\", \"extra\"),\n    (\"init\", \"extra\"),\n    (\"account\",),\n    (\"account\", \"frob\", \"X\"),\n    (\"account\", \"add\", \"X\"),\n    (\"account\", \"get\"),\n    (\"account\", \"rename\", \"X\"),\n    (\"account\", \"delete\"),\n    (\"txn\",),\n    (\"txn\", \"post\", \"A\"),\n    (\"txn\", \"get\"),\n    (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\"),\n    (\"txn\", \"delete\"),\n    (\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\"),\n    (\"report\", \"balances\", \"extra\"),\n]\nfor args in cases:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n    print(args, code, err)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len([ln for ln in err.splitlines() if ln.strip()]) == 1\n=== END AC contract-usage-inprocess ===\n\n=== AC contract-usage-executable ===\nIntent: The ledger executable itself exits 2 with empty stdout for an unknown command and an unknown report.\n\nimport subprocess\n\nfor args in ([\"frobnicate\"], [\"report\", \"nosuch\"]):\n    result = subprocess.run([\"./ledger\", *args], capture_output=True, text=True)\n    print(result.stdout)\n    print(result.stderr)\n    assert result.returncode == 2\n    assert result.stdout == \"\"\n=== END AC contract-usage-executable ===\n\n=== AC contract-csv-format ===\nIntent: Successful output is a single header and comma-separated rows with newline endings and no trailing spaces.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\nassert out.endswith(\"\\n\")\nassert \"\\r\" not in out\nlines = out.split(\"\\n\")[:-1]\nassert all(ln == ln.rstrip() for ln in lines)\nassert '\"' not in out\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows[0] == [\"table\", \"rows\"]\nassert [r[0] for r in rows[1:]] == [\"accounts\", \"categories\", \"transactions\"]\nassert all(len(r) == 2 and r[1].isdigit() for r in rows[1:])\n=== END AC contract-csv-format ===\n\n=== AC contract-amount-format ===\nIntent: Amounts are written with exactly two decimals and a leading minus when negative.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef fmt(c):\n    return f\"{Decimal(c) / 100:.2f}\"\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZCT1\", \"ZZCTC\"\nempty = \"ZZCT2\"\ncents = -1250\ntid = 900005001\nday, memo = \"2026-07-01\", \"contract row\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Contract One\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=empty, name=\"Contract Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Contract category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", acct)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [acct, \"Contract One\", \"1\", fmt(cents)]\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", empty)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[1][3] == fmt(0)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(tid))\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(tid), day, acct, cat, fmt(cents), memo]\n=== END AC contract-amount-format ===\n\n=== AC contract-failures-silent ===\nIntent: Rejected and not-found commands exit with their declared code and write nothing to stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nabsent = \"ZZCTNONE\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=absent) is None\n    cases = [\n        ((\"account\", \"get\", absent), 4),\n        ((\"account\", \"add\", \"bad code!\", \"Invalid\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"get\", \"abc\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"get\", \"900005999\"), 4),\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", absent, \"ZZNOCAT\", \"1.00\", \"2026-07-01\"), 3),\n    ]\n    for args, want in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == want\n        assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC contract-failures-silent ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only and their wording is never compared.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output.\n- Money is written from integer cents with no floating point and no thousands separator.\n=== END ARTIFACT BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportBalances.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Balances\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger report balances` command lists each account with its transaction count and balance, then a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md |\n| Provides | ledger report balances |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.balances.balance_cents, cli.output.write_table, ledger_app.store.open_store |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report balances` computes, from stored transactions, one row per account ordered by account\ncode, followed by a TOTAL row. Every value is aggregated in integer cents in the service layer from list\nresults; no value is hardcoded.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report balances` takes no further arguments. A wrong argument count is a usage error (exit 2).\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Open the store through `open_store`.\n2. List accounts (ordered by code) and list transactions.\n3. For each account, count its transactions and sum their amounts in integer cents.\n4. Write the header `account,name,transactions,balance`, one row per account, then\n   `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>` where count is the number of transactions across all accounts and sum is\n   the sum of all balances. Amounts are formatted with two decimals.\n5. With no accounts the output is the header and `TOTAL,,0,0.00`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: list accounts by code - supplies: none - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n\n## Reads\n\nAccounts and transactions. Writes: none.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC balances-rows ===\nIntent: The balances report shows each seeded account with its transaction count and balance computed from stored rows.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef fmt(c):\n    return f\"{Decimal(c) / 100:.2f}\"\n\na1, a2, cat = \"ZZRB1\", \"ZZRB2\", \"ZZRBC\"\nn1, n2 = \"Report One\", \"Report Two\"\nplan = {a1: [100050, -2500], a2: [750]}\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=a1, name=n1)\n    db.accounts.create(account=a2, name=n2)\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Report category\")\n    tid = 900001000\n    for acct, amts in plan.items():\n        for c in amts:\n            tid += 1\n            db.transactions.create(\n                txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=c, memo=\"\"\n            )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    by = {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:-1]}\n    for acct, amts in plan.items():\n        assert by[acct][2] == str(len(amts))\n        assert by[acct][3] == fmt(sum(amts))\n    assert by[a1][1] == n1\n    assert by[a2][1] == n2\n=== END AC balances-rows ===\n\n=== AC balances-order-total ===\nIntent: Account rows are ordered by code and the TOTAL row equals the sums of the listed rows.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\ncat = \"ZZRBD\"\naccts = [\"ZZRB4\", \"ZZRB3\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Order category\")\n    for i, a in enumerate(accts):\n        db.accounts.create(account=a, name=\"Order \" + a)\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900001100 + i, date=\"2026-05-02\", account=a, category=cat,\n            amount=1000 * (i + 1), memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    data, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    codes = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert codes == sorted(codes)\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(int(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[3]) == sum(cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n=== END AC balances-order-total ===\n\n=== AC balances-reflect-stored ===\nIntent: A transaction stored between two report runs changes the reported balance and count by exactly its amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\ndef row_for(out, acct):\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    return {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:-1]}[acct]\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZRB5\", \"ZZRBE\"\nfirst, second = 5000, -1250\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Reflect\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Reflect category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900001201, date=\"2026-05-03\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=first, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    assert code == 0\n    before = row_for(out, acct)\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900001202, date=\"2026-05-04\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=second, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    after = row_for(out, acct)\n    assert int(after[2]) == int(before[2]) + 1\n    assert cents(after[3]) == cents(before[3]) + second\n=== END AC balances-reflect-stored ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Never hardcode a balance, count, or total; every value is aggregated from stored rows.\n- Money is integer cents at every layer; no floating point.\n- A failing run writes nothing to stdout.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Categories\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger report categories` command lists every category with transaction count, inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md |\n| Provides | ledger report categories |\n| Consumes | cli.output.write_table, ledger_app.store.open_store |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report categories` totals stored transactions by category, including categories that have no\ntransactions, and ends with a TOTAL row. Aggregation is done in integer cents from list results.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report categories` takes no further arguments; a wrong argument count exits 2.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Open the store through `open_store`.\n2. List categories (ordered by code) and list transactions.\n3. For each category count its transactions; `inflow` sums positive amounts; `outflow` sums the\n   absolute values of negative amounts and is written as a positive number; `net` is\n   `inflow - outflow`.\n4. Write the header `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net`, a row for every category,\n   then `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.\n5. With no transactions, every category shows 0 transactions and 0.00 for inflow, outflow, and net,\n   followed by the zero TOTAL row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: list categories by code - supplies: none - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `category`, `amount`\n\n## Reads\n\nCategories and transactions. Writes: none.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC categories-rows ===\nIntent: The categories report shows computed inflow, outflow, and net for a used category and zeros for an empty one.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef fmt(c):\n    return f\"{Decimal(c) / 100:.2f}\"\n\nused, empty, acct = \"ZZRCA\", \"ZZRCB\", \"ZZRCACC\"\namts = [10000, 2550, -3000]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Cat Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=used, description=\"Used category\")\n    db.categories.create(category=empty, description=\"Empty category\")\n    for i, c in enumerate(amts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900002001 + i, date=\"2026-05-05\", account=acct, category=used,\n            amount=c, memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"category\", \"description\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    by = {r[0]: r for r in rows[1:-1]}\n    inflow = sum(c for c in amts if c > 0)\n    outflow = sum(-c for c in amts if c < 0)\n    r = by[used]\n    assert r[1] == \"Used category\"\n    assert r[2] == str(len(amts))\n    assert r[3] == fmt(inflow)\n    assert r[4] == fmt(outflow)\n    assert r[5] == fmt(inflow - outflow)\n    z = by[empty]\n    assert z[2] == \"0\"\n    assert z[3] == fmt(0)\n    assert z[4] == fmt(0)\n    assert z[5] == fmt(0)\n=== END AC categories-rows ===\n\n=== AC categories-order-total ===\nIntent: Category rows are ordered by code and the TOTAL row equals the column sums with net equal to inflow minus outflow.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\nacct = \"ZZRCACD\"\ncats = [\"ZZRCD2\", \"ZZRCD1\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Total Account\")\n    for i, c in enumerate(cats):\n        db.categories.create(category=c, description=\"Total \" + c)\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900002101 + i, date=\"2026-05-06\", account=acct, category=c,\n            amount=(500 if i == 0 else -200), memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"categories\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    data, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    codes = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert codes == sorted(codes)\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == sum(int(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[3]) == sum(cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[4]) == sum(cents(r[4]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[5]) == cents(total[3]) - cents(total[4])\n    assert all(cents(r[4]) >= 0 for r in data)\n=== END AC categories-order-total ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every category appears, including those with no transactions.\n- `outflow` is a positive number; `net` is `inflow - outflow`.\n- Never hardcode a total; all values come from stored rows in integer cents.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Monthly\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger report monthly` command lists each month that has transactions with count, inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md |\n| Provides | ledger report monthly |\n| Consumes | cli.output.write_table, ledger_app.store.open_store |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report monthly` groups stored transactions by the `YYYY-MM` prefix of their date and reports\neach month in ascending order with a TOTAL row. Aggregation is in integer cents.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`./ledger report monthly` takes no further arguments; a wrong argument count exits 2.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Open the store through `open_store`.\n2. List transactions and group by the first seven characters of `date`.\n3. For each month count transactions, sum positive amounts as `inflow`, sum absolute values of\n   negative amounts as `outflow`, and compute `net = inflow - outflow`.\n4. Write the header `month,transactions,inflow,outflow,net`, one row per month that has\n   transactions in ascending order, then `TOTAL,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.\n5. With no transactions, write only the header and the zero TOTAL row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `amount`\n\n## Reads\n\nTransactions. Writes: none.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC monthly-rows ===\nIntent: Stored transactions change their month's count, inflow, outflow, and net by amounts derived from the fixtures.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\ndef parse(out):\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    return {r[0]: (int(r[1]), cents(r[2]), cents(r[3]), cents(r[4])) for r in rows[1:-1]}\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZRMACC\", \"ZZRMC\"\nfixtures = [\n    (\"2098-01-05\", 10000),\n    (\"2098-01-20\", -2500),\n    (\"2098-02-03\", 700),\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Monthly Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Monthly category\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    assert code == 0\n    before = parse(out)\n    for i, (day, c) in enumerate(fixtures):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900003001 + i, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=c, memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"month\", \"transactions\", \"inflow\", \"outflow\", \"net\"]\n    after = parse(out)\n    for month in sorted({d[:7] for d, _ in fixtures}):\n        amts = [c for d, c in fixtures if d[:7] == month]\n        inflow = sum(c for c in amts if c > 0)\n        outflow = sum(-c for c in amts if c < 0)\n        b = before.get(month, (0, 0, 0, 0))\n        a = after[month]\n        assert a[0] - b[0] == len(amts)\n        assert a[1] - b[1] == inflow\n        assert a[2] - b[2] == outflow\n        assert a[3] - b[3] == inflow - outflow\n=== END AC monthly-rows ===\n\n=== AC monthly-order-total ===\nIntent: Month rows ascend and the TOTAL row equals the sums of the month rows.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef cents(s):\n    return int(Decimal(s) * 100)\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZRMAC2\", \"ZZRMD\"\ndates = [\"2097-03-01\", \"2097-01-10\", \"2097-02-11\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Monthly Order\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Monthly order\")\n    for i, d in enumerate(dates):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900003101 + i, date=d, account=acct, category=cat,\n            amount=(1000 if i != 1 else -300), memo=\"\"\n        )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"monthly\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    data, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    months = [r[0] for r in data]\n    assert months == sorted(months)\n    assert len(months) == len(set(months))\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert int(total[1]) == sum(int(r[1]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[2]) == sum(cents(r[2]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[3]) == sum(cents(r[3]) for r in data)\n    assert cents(total[4]) == cents(total[2]) - cents(total[3])\n=== END AC monthly-order-total ===\n\n=== AC monthly-month-shape ===\nIntent: Every month label is a YYYY-MM value taken from stored transaction dates.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZRMAC3\", \"ZZRME\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Monthly Shape\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Monthly shape\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900003201, date=\"2096-12-31\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=100, memo=\"\"\n all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d{2}\", r[0]) for r in data)\n    assert \"2096-12\" in [r[0] for r in data]\n=== END AC monthly-month-shape ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Only months that have transactions appear as rows.\n- Never hardcode a month, count, or total; every value comes from stored rows in integer cents.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AtomicCommands.md ===\n# FEATURE: Atomic Commands\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Assembly of the member write commands proving that every rejected command checks everything first and changes nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-AccountAdd.md, FEATURE-AccountRename.md, FEATURE-AccountDelete.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-TxnAmend.md, FEATURE-TxnDelete.md, FEATURE-TransferRules.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md |\n| Provides | ledger atomic-command guarantee |\n| Consumes | ledger load, ledger account add, ledger account rename, ledger account delete, ledger txn post, ledger txn amend, ledger txn delete, ledger transfer |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nEvery write command validates all inputs and rules before its first write. This assembly story drives\nrejected invocations of each write command through the built CLI and compares a full snapshot of\naccounts, categories, and transactions before and after. Gaps found are fixed in the member stories'\ncode. Writes within one command share the persistence library's transaction scope where it offers\none, so two concurrent commands each complete in full or change nothing; the concurrent case is\nverified by the project's own pytest suite against a temporary database.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: list accounts - supplies: none - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: list categories - supplies: none - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC atomic-load-transactions ===\nIntent: A transaction file with an unknown account or a negative final balance is rejected with exit 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport dataclasses\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef tup(r):\n    if isinstance(r, dict):\n        return tuple(sorted(r.items()))\n    return dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\ndef write(path, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZAT1\", \"ZZATC\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Atomic One\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category\")\n    before = snap(db)\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        unknown = os.path.join(d, \"unknown.csv\")\n        write(unknown, [\n            [900004001, \"2026-06-01\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"ok one\"],\n            [900004002, \"2026-06-01\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"ok two\"],\n            [900004003, \"2026-06-01\", \"ZZNONE\", cat, \"10.00\", \"unknown\"],\n        ])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", unknown)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert snap(db) == before\n        negative = os.path.join(d, \"negative.csv\")\n        write(negative, [\n            [900004011, \"2026-06-02\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"deposit\"],\n            [900004012, \"2026-06-03\", acct, cat, \"-20.00\", \"overdraw\"],\n        ])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", negative)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-load-transactions ===\n\n=== AC atomic-load-lookups ===\nIntent: Account and category files with duplicate codes, stored codes, or short rows are rejected with exit 3 and store nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport dataclasses\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef tup(r):\n    if isinstance(r, dict):\n        return tuple(sorted(r.items()))\n    return dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\ndef write(path, header, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow(header)\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nstored = \"ZZAT6\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=stored, name=\"Stored\")\n    before = snap(db)\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        dup = os.path.join(d, \"dup.csv\")\n        write(dup, [\"account\", \"name\"], [[\"ZZATN1\", \"New One\"], [\"ZZATN1\", \"New Again\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", dup)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n        clash = os.path.join(d, \"clash.csv\")\n        write(clash, [\"account\", \"name\"], [[\"ZZATN2\", \"New Two\"], [stored, \"Clash\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", clash)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n        short = os.path.join(d, \"short.csv\")\n        write(short, [\"category\", \"description\"], [[\"ZZATK1\", \"Fine\"], [\"ZZATK2\"]])\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", short)\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-load-lookups ===\n\n=== AC atomic-account-commands ===\nIntent: Rejected and not-found account commands change no stored record.\n\nimport dataclasses\n\nfrom cli.testing import return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\nacct, cat, absent = \"ZZAT2\", \"ZZATC2\", \"ZZAT2NONE\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=absent) is None\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Atomic Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category two\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900004101, date=\"2026-06-04\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=500, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before = snap(db)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", acct, \"Duplicate\")\n    assert code == 3 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"bad code!\", \"Invalid\")\n    assert code == 3 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", absent, \"Nobody\")\n    assert code == 4 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", acct)\n    assert code == 3 and out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", absent)\n    assert code == 4 and out == \"\"\n    assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-account-commands ===\n\n=== AC atomic-txn-commands ===\nIntent: Rejected and not-found transaction commands change no stored record.\n\nimport dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZAT3\", \"ZZATC3\"\ndeposit, withdrawal = 900004201, 900004202\nabsent_id = \"900004299\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Atomic Three\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category three\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=deposit, date=\"2026-06-05\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=withdrawal, date=\"2026-06-06\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-6000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before = snap(db)\n    cases = [\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-50.00\", \"2026-06-07\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, \"ZZNOCAT\", \"1.00\", \"2026-06-07\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-02-30\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.234\", \"2026-06-07\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"amend\", str(deposit), \"10.00\"), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"delete\", str(deposit)), 3),\n        ((\"txn\", \"amend\", absent_id, \"1.00\"), 4),\n        ((\"txn\", \"delete\", absent_id), 4),\n    ]\n    for args, want in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == want\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert snap(db) == before\n=== END AC atomic-txn-commands ===\n\n=== AC atomic-transfer ===\nIntent: Rejected transfers store neither leg, while a valid transfer stores both.\n\nimport dataclasses\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef tup(r):\n    if isinstance(r, dict):\n        return tuple(sorted(r.items()))\n    return dataclasses.astuple(r)\n\ndef snap(db):\n    return (\n        [tup(r) for r in db.accounts.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.categories.list()],\n        [tup(r) for r in db.transactions.list()],\n    )\n\nsrc, dst, cat = \"ZZAT4\", \"ZZAT5\", \"ZZATC4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Dest\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Atomic category four\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900004301, date=\"2026-06-08\", account=src, category=cat, amount=5000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    before = snap(db)\n    cases = [\n        (\"transfer\", src, dst, \"500.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n        (\"transfer\", src, src, \"1.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n        (\"transfer\", src, dst, \"0.00\", \"2026-06-09\"),\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert snap(db) == before\n    count_before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-06-09\")\n    print(out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == count_before + 2\n=== END AC atomic-transfer ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A rejected command writes nothing to stdout and stores no partial rows.\n- All inputs and the balance rule are checked before the first write of every command.\n- Concurrent-command atomicity is verified in the project's pytest suite, never by spawning processes in story acceptance.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-CliContract.md ===\n# FEATURE: CLI Contract\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Assembly of the ledger executable, usage-error behavior, and CSV output contract across every command. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-Count.md, FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-TxnGet.md, FEATURE-ReportBalances.md, FEATURE-ReportCategories.md, FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md |\n| Provides | ledger usage-error contract |\n| Consumes | ledger init, ledger count, ledger load, ledger account get, ledger txn get, ledger transfer, ledger report balances, ledger report categories, ledger report monthly |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`./ledger` exists at the application root and is executable. An unknown command, unknown table,\nunknown report, or wrong argument count exits 2 with exactly one stderr line showing the expected\nform and nothing on stdout. This story sweeps the command registry and confirms every registered\ncommand and sub-verb has a usage line and arity limits. Successful output is one header and\ncomma-separated unquoted rows with `\\n` endings and two-decimal amounts. Failures write nothing to\nstdout.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md and the member Feature files.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC contract-executable ===\nIntent: An executable named ledger exists at the application root.\n\nimport os\n\nassert os.path.isfile(\"ledger\")\nassert os.access(\"ledger\", os.X_OK)\n=== END AC contract-executable ===\n\n=== AC contract-usage-inprocess ===\nIntent: Unknown commands and wrong argument counts exit 2 with exactly one stderr line and no stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncases = [\n    (),\n    (\"frobnicate\",),\n    (\"report\",),\n    (\"report\", \"nosuch\"),\n    (\"load\", \"accounts\"),\n    (\"load\", \"nosuch\", \"file.csv\"),\n    (\"count\", \"extra\"),\n    (\"init\", \"extra\"),\n    (\"account\",),\n    (\"account\", \"frob\", \"X\"),\n    (\"account\", \"add\", \"X\"),\n    (\"account\", \"get\"),\n    (\"account\", \"rename\", \"X\"),\n    (\"account\",
